title: Ollama and LM Studio: models on your own machine

videos.script: Lesson 3 asked when running a model yourself pays. This lesson is how it is done. {{two-tools}} Two tools do most of it. Ollama, a server and a command line. LM Studio, a desktop app with a server inside. Both run the open weights of lessons 10 to 12, and both listen on your own machine. {{native}} Ollama's own API reports what each call cost in time, and keeps the model loaded for five minutes after. {{context}} It also reads four thousand tokens by default, and a longer conversation is cut to fit. Check what the model actually read. {{openai}} And both speak OpenAI's shape. The same program talks to either, by changing one address.
